products.name: New-Site Endpoint Rollout Playbook — Commercial
products.short_description: A repeatable new-site endpoint rollout playbook — a sequenced program that provisions devices, applies your baseline, deploys site apps and printers, validates, and runs a go-live checklist, so every new location opens the same proven way. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Open a new office, clinic, or site with endpoints that work on day one

Standing up endpoints at a new location — a new clinic, branch, or acquired office — usually means reinventing the rollout each time, scrambling on go-live day, and discovering missing apps, printers, or network access when staff are already trying to work. This solution is a repeatable new-site endpoint rollout playbook: a sequenced program that provisions devices, applies your baseline, installs the site's apps and printers, validates connectivity and identity, and runs a go-live checklist — so every new site opens the same proven way.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the new-site rollout model, the dependency order (network/identity → provisioning → baseline → apps/printers → validation → go-live), and how it reuses your existing Intune standards.
  • Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (Intune, Entra ID, the site's network/identity readiness, your device baseline, the site app/printer set, a go-live window) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.
  • Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps: confirm network/identity, build the site device group, provision devices, apply baseline, deploy site apps and printers, validate connectivity/identity/printing, run the go-live checklist, then expand to the next site.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — site-readiness discovery, per-device go-live validation, a site rollout status report, safe remediation of failed deployments, and a site device-group builder.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-once, repeat-everywhere model.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Every new site opening with endpoints that work on day one — provisioned, baselined, app- and printer-ready, and validated against a go-live checklist — proven on a pilot site before you repeat it everywhere.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • NEWSITE-Discovery.ps1 — new-site readiness check (network, identity, and time)
    • NEWSITE-Remediation.ps1 — safe remediation of failed site deployments (default -WhatIf)
    • NEWSITE-Report.ps1 — site rollout status report (Microsoft Graph)
    • NEWSITE-Set-SiteGroupTargeting.ps1 — build a per-site device group (Microsoft Graph)
    • NEWSITE-Validation.ps1 — per-device go-live validation for a new-site rollout

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
